## Safety and security review
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, credentials, or private user data are included.
- [ ] Inputs, authorization, and failure paths were considered where relevant.
- [ ] Any dependency or workflow permission changes use the least privilege needed.
- [ ] No public bind/deployment or sandbox safety guard was weakened.
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior has tests or a documented reason tests are not feasible.

## AI-assisted change review
- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff rather than relying only on the generated summary.
- [ ] I checked for unrelated changes, placeholders, unsafe defaults, and fabricated verification claims.
- [ ] Any remaining limitations or follow-up work are documented below.

- [ ] A human has reviewed and explicitly approved the final diff before any external fork/commit/PR publication action.
